rows.title: 01 — IDENTITY & DESCRIPTION
rows.description: Identify a manufacturer, reusable model, particular unit and API identity without collapsing them.

rows.definition: The producer's manufacturer name; not who operates the current station.
A reusable model is not an individual physical device.

SensorML.note: Reference to more general process, not a literal model-name field.

CSAPI.note: A model is reusable; a System remains an instance. Keep model ID separate from physical serial and API URL.

Dragino.caveat: S31B/LS alternatives excluded; not an installed unit

AirGradient.caveat: CE-S model suffix not assumed equivalent

Campbell.caveat: two separate product kinds; no installed pair authenticated

Bennett.caveat: model names belong to distinct equipment, not one station model

rows.definition: No API UID should be silently interpreted as a physical serial.

SAPIENT.note: Software-only nodes may use this for license/product numbers; not always hardware.

Bennett.caveat: two individuals used in three service periods, not three probes

rows.definition: Persistent identity of the described System—not a guaranteed equipment serial.

SensorML.note: Process identifier, scope must be distinguished.

CSAPI.note: A persistent System ID is not necessarily the manufactured item's physical serial.

Bennett.caveat: not an EE181 serial or a project-created CSAPI resource ID

rows.title: 02 — SYSTEM, EQUIPMENT & RELATIONSHIPS
rows.description: Describe the whole, physical constituents, separate connections, reporting participant and hosting context.

rows.definition: No single donor superclass has been adopted as the DIM root.

OPC.note: Devices may differ from the focal whole/station.

SOSA.note: SSN Systems need not be one physical enclosure.

SensorML.note: PhysicalSystem is a process-system construct; not universal root.

CSAPI.note: A focal reference arrangement, a manufactured assembly, a physical constituent, and a whole deployed station need not share one System identity.

Campbell.caveat: publisher examples not proof of actual joining

Bennett.caveat: station persists across changing instrument service roles

rows.definition: One visible network node cannot be assumed identical to one physical device.

IEEE.note: A network-side processor role, not universally the whole sensor.

SAPIENT.note: May be software-only or compound, not automatically a physical sensing element.

rows.definition: Differentiate part-of from merely connected, hosted or digitally exposed.

rows.title: 04 — CONFIGURATION & CONTROL
rows.description: Differentiate supported/default capabilities, applied/reported configuration and actual command execution.

rows.definition: An option a device supports isn't necessarily the one in use.

SensorML.note: Can be a configurable process mode.

SAPIENT.note: A declared mode, not proof it is active.

rows.definition: Don't promote a printed default to current effective state.

rows.definition: Keep source report time and subject; don't infer live state.

rows.definition: Supported command syntax ≠ an issued request.

rows.definition: ACCEPTED is not COMPLETED, and COMPLETED is not measured physical effect.

CSAPI.note: ACCEPTED is not execution success; a reported COMPLETED status should not be treated as independently measured physical effect.

limitations: The original v0.1 master workbook, mappings, donor inventory and proposed DIM remain unchanged.
W3C SOSA/SSN is W3C authority, grouped here for technical adjacency and NOT relabeled an OGC standard.
SWE Common column is reserved but unpopulated pending original-source correspondence checks.
Other donor ranking is provisional based on 7-donor historical sample, NOT final contribution order.
All 51 historical donor mapping cells retain PRIOR_SOURCE_EXTRACT_ONLY standing.
Case-column statements are prior project-reviewed design/example/historical-source references; they are NOT new original-publisher audits or automatic conformance evidence.
Nine case-only rows are review holds, NOT proposed/adopted DIM fields or donor equivalences.
Step08 owner acceptance is still pending. No Step09 source intake authorized.

Step09 checked CSAPI original published clauses for 12 existing donor correspondences but does not prove DIM adoption, equipment conformance, authentic historical observations or actual ControlStream/Command execution.
Eight additional CSAPI native-source capabilities are tracked as candidate alignments against the nine held case topics, not inserted as adopted DIM rows.
Other donor columns remain historical/unverified; original v0.2 and v0.1 remain unchanged.

sourceNativeHolds.negativeBoundary: A time-bounded deployment can associate a System with a platform. It is a candidate carrier for installed/service roles, not evidence of a particular Bennett's Point probe join or exact swap minute.
Part replacement is an event category, but a generic event record does not by itself specify full old/new serial IDs or the exact time of the Bennett EE181 change.
Station point or deployment area does not become the individually surveyed position of every probe.
Diagnostic/status datastreams are conceptually supported, but no actual Campbell Status event from an installed station has been obtained.
A dated change event does not furnish full previous/next configuration values or prove present effective settings.
Property definitions can distinguish an hourly mean from basic temperature, but do not prove the processing method executed or the source-to-result causal chain.
These temporal properties are required in CSAPI representation; historical source data may not furnish original resultTime, so do not invent it.
A declared live control channel and status vocabulary are not proof of authenticated command execution or observed physical effect.
